description: Get full details for a specific campaign by id. Returns merchant, products (each with price_cents, commission_cents and currency_code — amounts are in that store currency; commission is paid in USD at the order-date rate), commission_rate_pct, approval_mode (auto|manual — whether apply_to_campaign auto-approves), status, and ends_at (null when open-ended, with is_open_ended).
name: get_campaign
